name: icu Date toLocaleTimeString options hour12 hourCycle and timeZone
source: function main(): void { const d = new Date(Date.UTC(2024, 0, 15, 13, 5, 9)); console.log(d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "America/New_York" }), d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "Asia/Tokyo", hour12: false }), d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }), d.toLocaleTimeString("de-DE", { timeZone: "Europe/Berlin", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }), d.toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { timeZone: "UTC", hourCycle: "h23" }), d.toLocaleString("en-GB", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" })); }
